profiles.name: Maya Ortiz
profiles.backstory: Maya works three twelve-hour hospital shifts and shares an apartment with her sister. She likes supporting a party more than dealing damage, but she has abandoned streak apps after a difficult week. She wants a record of teach-back practice and gentle conditioning that survives a rota change. The care work in this scenario uses fictional cases; patient records never enter the app.
profiles.deliverable: A fictional discharge teach-back script checked against a role-appropriate rubric
profiles.motivation: A visible record of useful work and a fantasy character that develops alongside it.
profiles.success: Keep a sustainable routine, produce useful work, and earn the next class through its actual requirements.
profiles.constraints: Rotating shifts, four planned app days, no patient information, and one disrupted fortnight.

profiles.name: Tomas Vega
profiles.backstory: Tomas is a licensed electrician who supervises one apprentice and helps care for his father. He enjoys building things but has little interest in networking certificates. He wants his character to reflect fault finding, measurement and a steady return to lifting. His professional practice is a de-energized training example or drawing, not an app-directed live electrical repair.
profiles.deliverable: A checked training-board fault tree and labeled circuit drawing
profiles.motivation: A visible record of useful work and a fantasy character that develops alongside it.
profiles.success: Keep a sustainable routine, produce useful work, and earn the next class through its actual requirements.
profiles.constraints: Family care interrupts two evenings; energized electrical work is outside this simulation.

profiles.name: Ada Bennett
profiles.backstory: Ada teaches primary school and leads a small church choir. School preparation often consumes her evenings, so she wants a small teaching artifact to count more than a vague productivity timer. She likes JRPG support roles and wants a Maestro eventually. The model gives her a school-break gap rather than assuming that teachers maintain identical routines all year.

profiles.motivation: See teaching preparation and musical communication contribute to a support character.
profiles.success: Keep a sustainable routine, produce useful work, and earn the next class through its actual requirements.
profiles.constraints: Training, career practice and Adventures share a limited leisure budget; ordinary work is not automatically submitted for XP.
